mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm glad you're here. Have you ever wondered how science and faith might fit together, or what happens when curiosity about the universe meets questions of meaning and purpose? Let's explore that together as we step into the world of The Language of God, written by Francis S. Collins. Imagine peering into the secrets of our DNA, guided by someone who’s not only a pioneering geneticist but also someone who’s spent years wrestling with life's biggest questions—why are we here, what’s right and wrong, and could there be a deeper presence woven into the story of existence? In this journey, Collins invites us to see the boundaries between science and belief not as walls, but as open doors—where discovery and wonder, logic and longing, can walk side by side. We’ll uncover the marvels of genetic code, untangle the mysteries of biological complexity, and pause to reflect on the ethical puzzles that modern science brings. All the while, we’ll keep asking—what if the search for truth is both a scientific adventure and a spiritual quest? Get ready for a conversation that doesn’t pit science and faith against each other, but invites them to speak, question, and even inspire hope—together. So, as we begin, let’s stay curious and open-minded. We’re about to discover just how much there is to learn when we let science and belief share the same story.
